newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 28.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - RUSSIA IZVESTIA - APRIL 28.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the April 29 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- On a weekend visit to Voronezh, Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin welcomed the launch of a new long-haul Ilyushin-96T cargo plane with American engines which is the result of a joint U.S.-Russian project.
- The Russian army has no facilities to fight forest fires which have been triggering explosions in artillery depots in the Far East, according to a top Defence Ministry official.
- A "Cold War" is growing between the government's new young reformers and Prime Minister Chernomyrdin, who lacks allies since the recent cabinet reshuffle, says the paper.
